content:
Excited to share that I have successfully completed my internship at Pride & Justice Associates ! 🎉

Over the past month, I had the opportunity to work on legal research, drafting, and practical aspects of law under the guidance of experienced professionals. This internship helped me strengthen my understanding of legal procedures, improve my analytical skills, and gain valuable exposure to the professional legal environment.

I am grateful to Adv Shreya Dixit श्रेया दीक्षित and the entire team at Pride & Justice Associates for their guidance, support, and mentorship throughout this journey.

This experience has further motivated me to continue learning, growing, and contributing to the legal profession.
